engine: EVER 'Architecture' editorial-collage: static mixed-mask tile grid + wordmark-behind depth plane + floating decor with per-element mouse-parallax depth. Harvested from live EVER.

measured_live_EVER.wordmark: behind the tiles (z below), 108px, shows through the gutters
measured_live_EVER.meta: title group 40px @ x=965 (67%); '+' button 80x80 @ x=1310; counter @ x=50 y=589
measured_live_EVER.decor: 2 textured-sphere PNGs, MOUSE-parallax (NOT scroll). Measured drift: sphere1 ~±4px, sphere2 ~±2px (rest base offsets -85,-85 and -120,-120). Different amplitudes = layered depth. Per-axis differs (x vs y).
measured_live_EVER.note: the inner photo of the rect tile is offset (object-position style framing), not a parallax. The base composition is static; only the decor (and a touch of the wordmark) mouse-parallax.

decoSelector.what: the floating decor elements driven by mouse-parallax.

maxShiftPx.what: max pointer drift for a depth=1 element (depth scales it).

ease.what: lerp factor toward the pointer target (frame-rate-safe buttery damping).

wordmark.what: selector of the behind-plane word; if set it parallaxes a touch too.

wordmarkDepth.what: the wordmark plane's parallax amplitude (least, it sits deepest).

per_element_attrs.data-depth: 0..1 — this element's parallax amplitude (1 = full maxShiftPx). Different depths on different decor = layered depth.
per_element_attrs.data-axis: y amplitude vs x (default 0.8 — slightly less vertical drift, like EVER).
per_element_attrs.data-base-x / data-base-y: a resting transform offset preserved under the parallax (EVER's decor sit on a -tx,-ty base).

composition_is_config: the tile rects, masks, photos, decor art, copy, counter — all MARKUP/CSS per site. The engine drives ONLY the pointer-parallax of the decor (+ optional wordmark). Pair with fluid-type-sizing for the behind-word and section-pager for the section.
law: transform-only, GPU layers (will-change/backface-hidden), NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over moving decor. prefers-reduced-motion -> no parallax (static composed collage). NO WebGL.
proven: lab rebuilds the engine on OUR content: QUADRO renders in a round + rect tile, the word 'архітектура' behind (fluid-type-sized to 223px), 2 geometric decor at depth 1.0 / 0.55. Mouse left->right: deco1 ~38px, deco2 ~21px, word ~4px drift — depth-ordered parallax confirmed.
